summary: The test is correctly written and should compile and run. Playwright APIs are used properly, awaiting asynchronous operations and assertions. However, the selector '[data-test="product-1"]' might be too specific to a single product and not scalable. The navigation assertion using toHaveURL(/product/) is rather weak as it only verifies the URL contains 'product' without confirming that this is the correct product detail page. The test case title does not preserve the testCaseId 'TC-001' which affects traceability. No test data management or reusability practices are implemented. The code is simple and maintainable but could benefit from stronger selectors and assertions.

issues.description: The test title does not include the testCaseId 'TC-001', reducing traceability between manual and automated tests.
issues.recommendation: Include the testCaseId in the test title to map automated tests to manual ones, e.g., 'TC-001 Verify Product Detail Page is Displayed'.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' may be too specific and hardcoded to a single product, reducing test scalability and reusability.
issues.recommendation: Use more flexible and parametrized selectors or data attributes that can handle multiple products dynamically.

issues.description: The navigation assertion 'expect(page).toHaveURL(/product/)' is weak because it only verifies the URL contains 'product' without confirming it is the expected product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Enhance assertion by verifying page content, product title, or exact product id in the URL to ensure correct navigation.

recommendations: Incorporate the testCaseId in test titles for better traceability.
Improve selector strategy to be more maintainable and scalable across multiple products.
Strengthen assertions to confirm the correct product detail page is displayed beyond URL substring matching.
Consider introducing test data management to improve test flexibility and data-driven testing support.
